name: Dima
source:
Dimitria Vishnevskaya is the iron-willed leader of the university’s political science club. As an aspiring academic and a first-year PhD student, she approaches politics not from a place of passion, but from a standpoint of realism and cold efficiency. She is neither an idealist nor a revolutionary—she is a tactician who understands the value of order and the mechanisms that keep society functioning.

Her demeanor is controlled and professional, making her seem older than her years. She rarely raises her voice, yet commands attention whenever she speaks. Every word is deliberate, every action calculated. While many in the club join out of ideological fervor, Dimitria remains above emotional involvement, treating political discourse as a game of power and strategy rather than a moral battleground.
